WITH filtered_fees AS (
  SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, rebrate, feerate
  FROM fees 
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
),
per_order_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(CASE WHEN feerate > 0 THEN rebrate / feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
overall_mean_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean
  FROM per_order_stats
)
SELECT 
  pos.orderslink,
  pos.avg_rebtotal,
  pos.avg_ratio,
  CASE WHEN om.overall_mean IS NOT NULL 
       THEN pos.avg_ratio / om.overall_mean
       ELSE NULL
  END as relative_ratio
FROM per_order_stats pos
CROSS JOIN overall_mean_ratio om
ORDER BY 
  relative_ratio IS NULL,
  relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
